newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Blast rocks Swedish Hell's Angels club - agency.
newsitem.headline: Blast rocks Swedish Hell's Angels club - agency.

text.p: A club run by the Hell's Angels bikers gang in the southern Swedish city of Malmo was blasted by a powerful explosion in the early hours of Thursday, Swedish news agency TT said.
Seven ambulances as well as police and rescue services were on the scene, TT said.

Malmo police told Reuters four people, including a baby, had been injured in the blast and two had been taken to hospital, although their condition was not critical. None of the injured were connected with the Hell's Angels.
The bomb was placed in a property close to the Hell's Angels club, which was very badly damaged. Four people inside the clubhouse had not been hurt, the spokesman added.
He said that it was too early to make a firm connection between the blast and an escalating bikers' gang war that has claimed several lives over the past year.
